items.label: Loud Sirent + Strobe Light
items.value: A 130dB siren and flashing strobe work together to deter threats and signal for help - even in low light or loud surroundings.

items.label: Waterproof & Weather Resistant
items.value: Built for rain, snow, and humidity so it works when you need it most. Rated IP56 and tested for outdoor use day or night.

items.label: Activates Instantly with Pin Pull
items.value: Pull the pin to trigger the alarm immediately. Attaches to keys, purses, backpacks, or a wrist hair tie. TSA-approved for air travel and campus use.

items.label: Up to 365 Days Standby Battery Life
items.value: Built-in battery lasts up to 365 days on standby - no constant recharging or battery swaps. Compact and lightweight for all-day carry.

items.label: Gift Safety to Someone your Love
items.value: Compact, easy to use, and ready to carry from day one. A practical gift for college students, solo travelers, and anyone who values peace of mind.
